# dsh-native-playbook

> A community DeepSeek Harness plugin, Agent Skill, CLI, and Node API for discovering operational native DSH capabilities and safely activating reviewed native paths.

Promise: Unlock the DeepSeek Harness you already installed.

Repository: https://github.com/cyanseek/dsh-native-playbook
Upstream: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
License: MIT
Languages: English, Simplified Chinese

## Primary install

dsh plugin --profile web add github:cyanseek/dsh-native-playbook

The project is a DeepSeek Harness extension, not a standalone agent runtime. The npm package is not published yet.

## Runtime surface

- Tool: native_capability
- Input: a natural-language task
- Output: native recommendation, shipped/mounted/visible/providerReady/operational lifecycle, action, verification, and fallback
- Policy: prefer operational official DSH capabilities before external plugins or infrastructure workarounds

## Safe activation

- Allowlisted recipes only
- Explicit DSH version compatibility gate
- Atomic profile update, DSH composition check, automatic rollback
- No credential, security-policy, network-provider, or arbitrary-command mutations
- Verified Tier-1 recipe: official session full-text search on DSH 0.1.0-rc.6

## Other surfaces

- Agent Skill: skills/dsh-native-playbook/SKILL.md
- CLI: dsh-native --help
- Node API: package root export
- Repository impact metrics: pnpm metrics
- English documentation: README.md
- Chinese documentation: README.zh-CN.md
